parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

Instats is offering a new 2-day seminar Structural Equation Modeling in R livestreaming February 23–24, led by Scott Colwell (University of Guelph and Enablytics). This seminar introduces Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) in R, offering a robust framework for analyzing complex relationships, latent constructs, and measurement error within your research data. Participants will gain hands-on experience with R/lavaan to specify, estimate, and interpret models, including confirmatory factor analysis and mediation, directly enhancing their analytical toolkit. The skills acquired will enable researchers to build more rigorous, reproducible, and publishable analyses, advancing the validity and impact of their own empirical work.

Sign up today to secure your spot, and please share this opportunity with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
